generic_error_description: We couldn't verify your session. Please sign in again or contact your administrator if the problem continues.
token_size_description: The access token exceeds the maximum allowed size (4KB cookie limit) and cannot be processed.
token_size_cause: Root cause: excessive role claims included in the token payload.
step_reduce_roles: Reduce the number of roles assigned to the user
step_reissue_token: Reissue the token after role adjustment
no_permission: You don't have permission to view this application.
forbidden_subtitle: You need the composite:view permission (role AGRI_COMPOSITE_VIEWER or AGRI_COMPOSITE_ADMIN) to use this console. Contact your administrator.
overview_hint: How this composite is configured and what it serves. The console is read-only.
consent_mode_passthrough_hint: The partner's consent is forwarded as-is to each registry, which validates it with its own Consent Manager.
consent_mode_exchange_hint: The composite validates the partner's consent once at the exchange Consent Manager, which issues each registry its own consent receipt.
signing_kid_missing: No signing key: the composite cannot sign its requests to registries. Check the composite's keystore / Partner Management key.
load_errors_sub: Use case files that failed to load
activity_not_recorded_hint: This composite has no activity database configured, so calls are not recorded. Configure the composite's database to see calls here.
portals_hint: Partners, keys and consents are managed in these portals.
use_cases_hint: Published use cases: what each one reads from which registry, and who may call it.
load_errors_title: {count, plural, one {# use case file failed to load} other {# use case files failed to load}}
load_errors_hint: These files are not served until they are fixed.
sources_hint: Registry calls the use case makes. A mandatory source failing fails the call; an optional one is left out.
consent_required_hint: The partner's consent must grant at least the required scopes of each registry; optional scopes add data when granted.
consent_not_required_hint: This use case does not require a consent; the scopes below are what it reads.
output_fields_count: {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} in the response.
allowed_partners_hint: Partners that may call this use case (* = any partner registered in Partner Management).
registries_hint: Registries the composite reads from, and whether it can reach them.
data_scopes_hint: Scopes published by the registry. Expand a scope to see its fields.
data_scopes_hint_fetched: Scopes published by the registry (fetched {at}). Expand a scope to see its fields.
scopes_fetch_error: Could not read the registry's data scopes: {error}
scope_required_by: Required by this use case source
scope_optional_for: Optional for this use case source
partners_hint: Partners allowed by published use cases, with their keys in Partner Management.
no_partners: No partners are allowed by any published use case.
any_partner_hint: Any partner registered in Partner Management
activity_hint: Calls to the composite, newest first.
